The series is trend‑dominated with moderate ranking stability; a DBA (directional bias adjustment) may capture consistent under/over‑prediction bias across windows.

decision.justification: Selected 'dba on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.0962. Series context: trend strength 0.9746 and seasonal strength 0.0893; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.368); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 107.964.
